memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Now give me this hill country that the Lord promised me that day. You yourself heard then that the Anakites were there and their cities were large and fortified, but, the Lord helping me, I will drive them out just as he said." - Josh 14:12 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Here is the line that has inspired believers for centuries: "Give me this hill country." Of all the land available, Caleb asks for the hardest portion — the hill country where the Anakites, the giants, still lived in large fortified cities. He does not ask for the easy, settled valley. He asks for the mountain with giants on it.

Why would an eighty-five-year-old man choose the toughest assignment? Because Caleb's confidence was never in himself. Listen to his words: "the Lord helping me, I will drive them out just as he said." His courage rested entirely on God's promise and God's help. The giants that had terrified ten spies decades earlier did not frighten Caleb, because he was not measuring them against his own strength but against God's faithfulness.

This is faith at its finest — not the absence of giants, but confidence in God despite them. Caleb teaches us to face our mountains with the words "the Lord helping me." We are not called to pretend the giants are not real; we are called to trust that God is greater. Whatever hard hill country lies before you, the same God who backed Caleb's faith stands ready to help. And we go forward not in our own power but in the strength of Christ, who said we can do all things through Him who gives us strength (Phil 4:13).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- What "mountain" are you tempted to avoid because giants live there?
- Could you face it with Caleb's words: "the Lord helping me"?
- Where is God calling you to trust His strength rather than your own?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, give me Caleb's spirit — to face the hard mountains, not in my own strength, but trusting that with Your help I can do what You have called me to. Amen.
